measured_effect.metric: plateau_length_of_C3_at_value_10 (number of consecutive N with C3(N)=10)
measured_effect.ci_note: DEGENERATE BY CONSTRUCTION, and this is not a statistical dodge. Every value was obtained by EXHAUSTIVE constraint solving with CP-SAT status OPTIMAL, so the quantity has no sampling distribution and no uncertainty to interval-estimate. ci_low == ci_high == the exact measured value. A p_value would be meaningless here and is deliberately omitted rather than fabricated.

measurement: C3(N) = max |S|, S subset of {1..N}, with no x1,x2,x3,x4 in S satisfying x1-3*x2+3*x3-x4=0
instrument: Google OR-Tools CP-SAT exact maximisation; only status OPTIMAL accepted
independent_check: every returned witness re-verified directly from the defining relation, not from the solver model
reproduction_note: computed twice: once inside the rapid-fire loop, once from scratch in a separate process with no model in the path. Identical values both times.
negative_control: the same engine reproduces OEIS A003002 (r_3) 30/30 and the classical sum-free maximum ceil(N/2); a vacuity guard rejects relations that forbid nothing
